Generals: Amkaos, Kathutet and Ranyu
Molag Bal's Commentaries: Now you face my chosen soldiers. Kathutet, Amkaos, Ranyu! Destroy these worms!

Generals: Kathutet, Amkaos, Ranyu! Time to torture some mortals!
Anaxes and Medrike
Molag Bal's Commentaries: The Xivilai make excellent torturers and guards. Let's test them against you.

Generals: Xivilai know no honor. Anaxes and Medrike will test their strength, not yours.
Dregas Volar
Molag Bal's Commentaries: Lord of Magas Volar, Bearer of the Daedric Crescent, serve me and destroy the mortals!

Generals: From your sanctuary on Vvardenfell, I summon you, Lord Dregas Volar.
Dylora, Jansa and Vika
Molag Bal's Commentaries: Loyalties are fickle among the Dark Seducers. Face now the least loyal but most deadly.

Generals: The Seducers are known for their subtlety, but I find they have many strengths.
Fangaril, King Styriche of Verkarth and Zayzahad
Molag Bal's Commentaries: From deep beneath Cyrodiil, I summon Fangaril! Consume them, each one!

Generals: Your flesh is nothing but mort meat to Fangaril.
Gedna Relvel
Molag Bal's Commentaries: From deep beneath Morrowind, I summon the lich Gedna Relvel!

Generals: Let's see if you can withstand the might of Gedna Relvel, crimson witch of Mournhold.
Glut, Hogshead and Stumble
Molag Bal's Commentaries: Amusing. Let's see how you fare against these Ogrim.

Generals: Think you're strong? Have some Ogrim! Three of them!
Hrelvesuu
Molag Bal's Commentaries: Deep in dark Nchurdamz, I found Hrelvesuu. Come forth and destroy!

Generals: Some of my pets are fascinated by the toys of mortals. Hrelvesuu, show them!
Menta Na
Molag Bal's Commentaries: You will now be a gift to my most favored pet, Menta Na.

Generals: The daedroth Menta Na has served me well. He will destroy you.
Methats, Sumeer and Vonshala
Molag Bal's Commentaries: Most Dremora serve Dagon, but these serve me.

Generals: The Dremora know no fear, and admit no defeat.
Nomeg Haga
Molag Bal's Commentaries: Forged from ice at the heart of Coldharbour, Nomeg Haga will destroy you.

Generals: Now you face my personal slave. Nomeg Haga, come forth and stop these worms!
Ozzozachar
Molag Bal's Commentaries: My son, my child! Ozzozachar, destroy them!

Generals: Ozzozachar, my son! I summon you from the skies!
Rhagothan
Molag Bal's Commentaries: You've done well. Now it ends. Come, Rhagothan! Feast!

Generals: A mortal for you to feast upon, Rhagothan. You may feed now.
Velehk
Molag Bal's Commentaries: Blood on the water, Velehk this way comes. Your doom is upon you.

Generals: He'll tear you open and eat your heart raw. His eyes gleam red, his heart will never thaw.
Yggmanei
Molag Bal's Commentaries: Some prefer knowledge to strength. Yggmanei gives me both.

Generals: For your final test, meet Yggmanei. Even the Lord of Domination needs spies.
Zymel Hriz
Molag Bal's Commentaries: Can you withstand Zymel Hriz, an atronach of lightning and rock?

Generals: Most atronachs are weak. Some are strong. Zymel Hriz, I summon you!
